body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-08-12 (Q1FY27 concall transcript): "we should be able to do INR7,000 crores plus for this year ... And that should take us to a closing order book of INR10,000 crores plus ... About INR1,100 crores -- about INR1,100 crores. As I mentioned a 50% jump over last year." Metric: Order inflow / export inflow / closing order book FY27. Target: inflow >=7,000 cr; export ~1,100 cr; OB >=10,000 cr. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: Sep-26 order book INR 10,066 cr already above 10,000; H1 inflow 3,786 cr. Export inflow H1 ~INR 1,000-1,100 cr, already ~the August full-year figure. Raised to 7,500 / 1,500 in Oct-26.
